name: prismalens-monorepo
description: Open-source AI-powered incident analysis and root cause detection

//overrides.js-yaml@5: GHSA-pm4m-ph32-ghv5 (js-yaml 5.0.0-5.2.1, exponential parse time in flow collections). @nestjs/swagger 11.4.6 — the latest release — pins `js-yaml: 5.2.1` EXACTLY, so no parent bump reaches the patch. Scoped to the 5.x line on purpose: js-yaml 3.x (read-yaml-file) and 4.x (cosmiconfig, xmlbuilder2) are patched by plain resolution and must NOT be dragged to 5.x. REMOVE once @nestjs/swagger > 11.4.6 pins js-yaml >= 5.2.2.
//overrides.esbuild: GHSA-g7r4-m6w7-qqqr (esbuild 0.27.3-0.28.0, dev-server arbitrary file read on Windows). tsup 8.5.1 — the latest release — declares `esbuild: ^0.27.0`, which excludes every patched version; vite 8.2.1 already admits ^0.28.0 and 0.28.1 is independently in the tree via tsx/webpack/unplugin, so this override merely unifies the tree on the patched major-minor. REMOVE once tsup > 8.5.1 declares esbuild ^0.28.0.
//overrides.proxy-addr: GHSA-jqcg-44mw-7w3h (proxy-addr <2.0.8, IPv4-mapped IPv6 trust-subnet spoofing). Via express 5.2.1, which declares ^2.0.7. REMOVE once express pulls >=2.0.8 by plain resolution.
//overrides.qs: GHSA-4mjr-xmp4-gh2g, GHSA-x5fp-wj9c-mxmx (qs <6.16.0 DoS and array-limit bypass). Via express 5.2.1 / body-parser. REMOVE once they pull >=6.16.0.
//overrides.shell-quote: GHSA-pqg4-j6r4-53mv (shell-quote <1.11.0, quote() injection via line terminator). Dev-only via concurrently 10.0.5. REMOVE once concurrently pulls >=1.11.0.
//overrides.source-map-js: GHSA-68fv-2mgg-jv7q (source-map-js <1.2.2, event-loop DoS). Build-only via vite/postcss. REMOVE once no parent resolves 1.2.1.
//overrides.mysql2: GHSA-3f6p-5ww8-9rcr, GHSA-rgwj-5xj2-c3m3 (mysql2 <3.23.1). Only the prisma CLI optional peer; PrismaLens never opens MySQL. REMOVE once prisma resolves >=3.23.1.
//overrides.multer: GHSA-535w-7cp7-47q4, GHSA-wc9g-mqfw-jrwm, GHSA-qfvm-cv95-jqjf, GHSA-qvfw-j98x-7q72, GHSA-3pph-fpjx-jg34 (multer <2.4.0). Via @nestjs/platform-express. REMOVE once it pulls >=2.4.0.
//overrides.http-cache-semantics: Dependabot #175 (http-cache-semantics <=4.2.0, max-stale serving cross-user shared-cache responses). 4.3.0 is the advisory's patched floor and clears the alert; it does not fully fix max-stale, which upstream disputes. Dev-only via electron-builder > @electron/get > got > cacheable-request (^4.0.0), a private download cache, so PrismaLens produces no shared-cache response to harden. REMOVE once cacheable-request pulls >=4.3.0 by plain resolution.
//overrides.@prisma/config>deepmerge-ts: Dependabot #161 (deepmerge-ts <8.0.0, stack exhaustion on recursive graphs). @prisma/config 7.10.0 — the latest release — pins `deepmerge-ts: 7.1.5` EXACTLY. REMOVE once @prisma/config pins >=8.0.0.
//overrides.@prisma/adapter-better-sqlite3>better-sq: @prisma/adapter-better-sqlite3 7.10.0 — the latest release — declares `better-sqlite3: ^12.6.0`, whose 12.x line ships prebuilds only through an install script that npm 12 no longer runs. 13.x carries N-API prebuilds inside its tarball and the adapter passes the database suite on it, so it shares the workspace's 13.x copy. REMOVE once the adapter's range admits ^13.
